Color Mixer

Blend any two colors with a ratio slider — see the real mixed result as HEX and RGB with a live preview.

–
HEX result

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the two colors to mix.
  2. Drag the ratio slider to control how much of each color is used.
  3. Copy the resulting HEX or RGB value.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the mix calculated?

Linear interpolation in RGB space: each channel is mixed as a×ratio + b×(1−ratio), then rounded to the nearest integer.

Is this the same as mixing paint?

No — this is light-based (screen) mixing in RGB space, not subtractive pigment mixing. For print-like results, a CMYK model would be needed.

What does 50% mean?

An exact halfway blend of both colors — equal parts color A and color B.
